# Andrew Ryan Marketing

> Andrew Ryan Marketing is a contractor marketing agency in Johnson City, Tennessee, serving contractors and home-service companies nationwide. We measure marketing to the booked job -- not the lead -- and publish original research on how AI answer engines recommend local businesses.

This site contains service pages, industry-specific marketing hubs, and deep-dive guides organized by contractor vertical. The deepest content is in four topical authority silos -- window and door, remodeling, flooring, and fencing -- each with a hub page and supporting guides covering SEO, lead generation, PPC, and marketing systems for that industry.

The site also publishes The Answer Gap Index, first-party research comparing who AI engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overview, Google AI Mode) recommend for local businesses against who Google ranks, and the 6-Gap Revenue Map, a free diagnostic that shows which of six gaps between a search and a booked job costs a business the most.

## Core Pages

- [Andrew Ryan Marketing -- Homepage](https://andrewryanmarketing.com/): Agency overview, services offered, and client results for local service businesses seeking lead generation and SEO in the Tri-Cities Tennessee region and nationally
- [About Andrew Ryan Marketing](https://andrewryanmarketing.com/about/): Agency background, founder Andrew Ryan, and the data-driven marketing philosophy built on Google Search Console performance data and competitive intelligence
- [Marketing Services](https://andrewryanmarketing.com/services/): Full service listing -- SEO, lead generation, paid advertising, reputation management, email marketing, and industry-specific marketing systems for contractors
- [Industries We Serve](https://andrewryanmarketing.com/industries/): All contractor and service verticals served including remodeling, fencing, flooring, window and door, plumbing, HVAC, roofing, electrical, painting, landscaping, pest control, cleaning, handyman, and medical
- [Local SEO Results and Case Studies](https://andrewryanmarketing.com/case-studies/): Documented client results including ranking improvements, visibility gains, and lead generation ROI across multiple contractor verticals
- [Contact](https://andrewryanmarketing.com/contact/): Free consultation scheduling and competitive marketing audit requests
- [Free ROI Calculator](https://andrewryanmarketing.com/free-roi-calculator/): Interactive revenue impact calculator using industry-specific conversion rates, average project values, and local search volume data

## Research and AI Visibility

- [The Answer Gap Index -- Edition 1 (2026)](https://andrewryanmarketing.com/answer-gap-index/): Original study of 720 AI answers across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overview and Google AI Mode for 12 local business types in Denver, Boise and Chattanooga. 60.5% of AI-recommended businesses were in neither Google's map pack nor its organic top 10 ("Ghost Winners"). Defines six measures: Ghost Winner Rate, Ghost Top-Pick Rate, AI Overview Trigger Rate, Top-Answer Lock Rate, Cross-Engine Agreement and Evidence Ownership Rate. Includes a follow-up study of what AI-named businesses have in common (more and fresher reviews, more referring domains; star rating made no difference). Downloadable PDF summary and city-level CSV.
- [Generative Engine Optimization Services](https://andrewryanmarketing.com/services/generative-engine-optimization/): How Andrew Ryan Marketing gets businesses named in AI answers (Answer Architecture), with the measures the Answer Gap Index tracks
- [AI Overview Proof](https://andrewryanmarketing.com/ai-overview-proof/): Dated, incognito captures of Google's AI Overview naming Andrew Ryan Marketing and a client on competitive national terms, with the method and its limits stated

## Diagnostics

- [The 6-Gap Revenue Map](https://andrewryanmarketing.com/6-gap-revenue-map/): Free diagnostic that scores six gaps between a search and a booked job -- visibility, authority, trust, speed, conversion and attribution -- and shows which one costs a business the most booked jobs
- [Lead to Booked Job](https://andrewryanmarketing.com/services/lead-to-booked-job/): The second funnel -- speed to lead, follow-up and estimate follow-up systems that turn leads a contractor already paid for into booked jobs
